summary: Assess registry workflows, improve data-quality checks and plan practical upgrades. Explore Social Registry 2.0 training and its hands-on outputs.
lede: Social Registry 2.0 is a responsive, data-informed approach to managing social registry records and operations. For registry officers, programme managers and data specialists, it supports assessing registration and update workflows, checking data quality and planning practical improvements. Exercises include mapping exceptions and access controls, building a data-quality scorecard and drafting a phased improvement roadmap.
audienceIntro: This course suits people who manage social registry records, workflows, data quality or the decisions that depend on registry information.
audience: Social Assistance Programme Managers using registry information
prerequisites: Intermediate-level experience in social protection programme operations, registry administration or beneficiary-data work is recommended. No coding is required. Exercises use Excel; bring a laptop with Excel available.
topics: Digital financial services, payments & fintech risk
